info.title: Dike API
info.description: Contract for the Dike production API.

200.description: Nearby trips from saved routes, within 5 km and one hour. Discovery does not confirm pickup compatibility.
Server-calculated pickup compatibility, valid for five minutes
Returns saved geometry; calculates and persists a preview when no saved route exists
Open a conversation without sending a message

latestPickupAt.description: Optional; defaults to four hours after trip departure

passengerRouteId.description: An owned route snapshot supplying the pickup and requested destination without another place search.
